items.label: Fabric
items.value: Designed for long hours at work. Our 60%Polyester/35%Rayon/5%Spandex blend is soft, stretchy, lightweight, and breathable. Completely non-sheer for worry-free wear. Keeps you cool and comfortable even during hot summer days.

items.label: Fashion designs
items.value: More than a basic tee! Features trendy ruffle sleeves and a loose fit that flatters shoulders and arms. The relaxed silhouette conceals upper arm concerns while creating a balanced, stylish look. Perfect for casual chic or put-together comfort.

items.label: Occasions
items.value: One top seamlessly fits every part of your life: pair with trousers for office wear, with jeans for casual outings, or wear alone for relaxed loungewear. Transitions effortlessly from work commute to weekend plans without missing a beat.

items.label: Matching
items.value: The ultimate versatile staple for your wardrobe. Wear with leggings for a slimming silhouette, with jeans for effortless French chic, or with skirts/trousers for a polished look. One top creates endless stylish possibilities.

items.label: Size
items.value: Designed with a precision cut for a consistent, true-to-size fit that flatters real body shapes. No more guessing between sizes. Please refer to our size chart in product images to find your perfect fit with confidence.
